standard_prerequisites.name: Closed is limit closed and fp

core_obligations: Closed envelope: finite-type-closed-in-fp gives a closed immersion X -> Y with Y -> S of finite presentation.
Quasi-compact control: Y is quasi-separated (separated permanence) and may be shrunk to a quasi-compact open containing X.
Limit system: closed-is-limit-fp writes X = lim X_i with X_i -> Y closed immersions of finite presentation; composition makes X_i -> S of finite presentation.
proof_roadmap: Closed immersion into an fp target.
Quasi-separated + quasi-compact control of the target.
Limit system via the closed-is-limit engine; fp conclusion.
difficulty_reason: Closed immersion into an fp Y (engine), quasi-separatedness of Y (citation), quasi-compact shrink of Y, the closed-is-limit engine gives the system, composition gives fp structure morphisms. Multi-engine assembly.

compared.difference: The sibling is the global finite presentation factorization (delivered as L30216); this lemma is the full limit-system statement with closed immersion transitions. Different statements.
